name: Claude Context
author: TermIAu
description: How much of Claude's context each session has used, as a pill on its panel — yellow, then red with the panel outlined — and /compact on its own when it gets full.

description.en: In the red the whole panel gets a pulsing red border: time to compact.
description.pt: No vermelho o painel inteiro ganha uma borda vermelha pulsando: é hora de compactar.

description.en: Sends /compact when the context reaches the limit below and Claude is idle.
description.pt: Manda o /compact quando o contexto chega no limite abaixo e o Claude está parado.

description.en: It has to be past the red; below it, red plus one applies.
description.pt: Tem de passar do vermelho; abaixo dele, vale o vermelho mais um.
